## Analysis overview

Selects safety laboratory records, retains scheduled and eligible end-of-treatment observations, standardizes parameter labels, and calculates n, mean, SD, and change-from-baseline summaries by visit and treatment.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADLBC`
- `ADLBH`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAM/PARAMCD`: laboratory test name/code
- `AVAL`: analysis result
- `CHG`: change from baseline
- `AVISIT/AVISITN`: analysis visit
- `AENTMTFL`: end-of-treatment record flag
- `SAFFL`: safety flag
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
